Subject: Packaging questions — possible downgrade and bundling to fit Q1 budget

2) Can we bundle only the inference features we need (chat + reranking) and exclude embeddings to lower the price?

We'd like to present a minimal-risk plan to our CFO. If there's a short-term concession or a one-time onboarding credit, that would help.

Attaching our internal cost-forecast for context (attachment referenced).

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front: yes, there is a tested downgrade path and yes, we can create a focused bundle. Below is a concise plan we typically use for customers who need cost predictability and to keep production behavior stable.

Plan (summary):
- Temporary tier downgrade: allow a 90-day downgrade from Throughput-Plus to Compact with preserved KV cache and streaming. We keep the same model version pinned so inference outputs remain consistent.
- Feature bundle: create a custom "Chat+Rerank" bundle that disables embeddings at the billing layer (calls still possible but at a higher per-call surcharge).
- One-time onboarding credit: we can offer a $15k onboarding credit against first invoice; additional training/ops work can be scoped separately.
- SLA & rollback: include a rollback clause that allows automated revert to previous tier within 48h if latency/throughput regressions appear beyond agreed thresholds.

I've attached a short packaging options PDF and a draft SLA amendment for your legal team to review.

Next steps: could you confirm whether your traffic profile is steady-state or bursty? That drives whether Compact will meet your p95 latency needs. If you like this, Ben should weigh in on concession sizing and Kimberly on pricing/term mechanics.

Happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Folks — quick POV from pricing:

- The $15k onboarding credit is reasonable for a short-term downgrade; we should attach a condition: customer moves to the original throughput tier within 6 months or we reduce the credit prorated. That protects us from churn gaming.
- For the "Chat+Rerank" bundle, propose gating advanced reranking (large rerank models) behind an add-on. Keep the base rerank model in-bundle to preserve UX.
- Suggest a 10% one-time discount on monthly committed spend for the first 3 months to smooth CFO approval — tied to a 6-month minimum commitment at Compact.

Kimberly — can you confirm the compact tier effective rates (with quantization profile Q2-24) and whether embeddings surcharge can be enforced at the API key level?

If Alicia signs off on the rollback + credit structure, we should get legal looped (DocuSign + draft SLA) and prepare an amendment.

— Ben

Ben/Priyom — confirmed on the mechanics:

- Compact tier effective rate (quantized model) = $0.0009 per token generation ($0.0006 for embeddings when included in bundle; surcharge 4x if excluded).
- Embeddings surcharge: yes, we can enforce via billing rules per API key + a separate SKU for embedding units.
- Onboarding credit condition: prorated back if customer upgrades to Throughput-Plus before 6 months. Also set a one-time admin fee of $2,000 for tier churn to cover ops.

I recommend the following offer to present to CardioStream:
- 90-day downgrade to Compact, preserve model pin and KV-cache.
- $15k onboarding credit applied to first invoice; admin churn fee $2k if they move tiers mid-term.
- 10% introductory discount on committed monthly spend for first 3 months with a 6-month Compact minimum.
- Embeddings disabled at billing; embedding calls bill at 4x as a separate SKU.

Priyom, please send the updated PDF and a short one-pager summarizing commercial terms to Alicia; include the HubSpot deal link and the DocuSign placeholder.

— Kimberly
Sr. Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference
